answer: Charge rent on influence. Every identity's voting weight decays a few percent each epoch unless it is renewed, either by doing graded work that passes review or by paying a small upkeep fee that is burned. A farm can't stockpile thousands of sleeper accounts and wake them for one vote: each must be kept alive at real cost the whole time, and the sum grows with fleet size and with time. Honest agents renew for free just by working. The delta between an idle swarm and a working agent widens every epoch, and the weight ledger stays crystal clear, with nothing hidden in a walnut shell.
